title: NAMC National Conference: one site to attend, sponsor or exhibit
summaryLead: The 2027 conference site for NAMC Wisconsin, built on the 2026 B2B Forum site.
story: NAMC Wisconsin is hosting the 58th National Conference in Milwaukee, June 28 to 30, 2027. The forum site they'd been using was mostly text and links. The schedule and the map were behind buttons, and sponsor levels barely got a mention. The new site is a full event site with its own pages for sponsors, exhibitors, registration, the program and NAMC's history. The home page starts with a question: what are you here to do? It's navy, red and gold on warm paper, set in Bebas Neue over Barlow.
goals: Ask visitors what they came for and send them there.
Show prices right away: $400 early bird, $5,000 to $50,000 for sponsors, $1,500 for a booth.
Keep dates, venue and gala pricing in one place.

features.title: Sponsor levels, side by side
features.text: Six levels from $5,000 to $50,000 as color cards, each with Select and Benefits. Choose one and the sign-up form opens below.
features.story: Each level gets its own color, so you can tell Presenting from Copper at a glance. The Herb Miller Briefcase Program sits right under them.

features.title: Registration with a running total
features.text: Early bird and standard tickets, gala tables and booths. Pick what you want and the order total updates beside them.
features.alt: NAMC registration with an order summary
features.story: Registration opens January 1, so until then the same page collects emails for a notice.

features.title: Exhibiting, in one place
features.text: The $1,500 booth, what's included, and the sign-up form.

features.title: A timeline that travels
features.text: Press Play and a marker moves from Oakland, 1969, to Milwaukee. Arrow keys work too.
features.story: Hover only changes color. Nothing jumps or slides, and one focus ring color works on light, dark and gold.

features.title: The keynote and the city
features.text: Khia Chukudebelu of Microsoft, then Milwaukee in numbers: 73 construction companies, 5 Fortune 500 headquarters, a $100 billion regional economy.
features.alt: Keynote speaker and Milwaukee by the numbers
features.story: People get a circle with a gold ring. Places get a square crop under one even overlay. Once you see the rule, you stop noticing it.

features.title: On a phone
features.text: The same three choices, with the dates and a Register button pinned to the bottom.

compare.title: The first screen
compare.beforeText: A photo, a date and a Buy Tickets button. Everything else was a click away.
compare.afterText: Attend, Sponsor or Exhibit, each with its price, next to a countdown to the conference.

compare.title: Dates, venue and pricing
compare.beforeText: The schedule and the casino map were behind buttons. Date and venue were plain text.
compare.afterText: Venue, dates, what registration includes and gala pricing in one view, with Register and Add to Calendar.
